scene park_night
I find myself walking through a park in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 我发现自己正穿行在深夜里的一座公园中。

lines.en: Everyone is gone and I am finally happy.
lines.zh: 所有人都不见了，我终于开心了。

lines.en: I think about taking my clothes off and celebrating this newfound freedom by streaking through the roads, but decide against it when I realize there isn’t anyone who’d be able to see.
lines.zh: 我想过把衣服脱光，用裸奔穿过马路来庆祝这份新得的自由，但一想到反正也没有人看得见，就打消了念头。

lines.en: Plus, it’s getting kind of cold out anyway.
lines.zh: 再说，外面也有点冷了。

lines.en: When it’s cold, my penis gets smaller and I wouldn’t want something like that to embarrass me in front of any {b}ghosts{/b} that might be lurking around here.
lines.zh: 天一冷，我的阴茎就会缩水，我可不想在可能潜伏在这附近的{b}鬼魂{/b}面前丢那种脸。

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel like I’m supposed to be doing something right now.
lines.zh: : 我总忍不住觉得，自己现在应该去做什么事。

lines.en: : But what was it?
lines.zh: : 可那是什么来着？

lines.en: I quickly begin to go over a number of different things that pop into my head.
lines.zh: 我迅速在脑中过了一遍冒出来的各种念头。

lines.en: Among them and roughly nine or five installments down the line is thought of a rooftop and a girl much shorter than me.
lines.zh: 其中大概隔了九章还是五章的位置，浮现出一个天台，和一个比我矮得多的女孩。

lines.en: The unfortunate part of this fleeting thought is that every girl I know is shorter than me, so that could mean pretty much anyone.
lines.zh: 这个一闪而过的念头有个不巧的地方——我认识的每个女孩都比我矮，所以那基本上可能是任何人。

lines.en: : Ugh. Teenagers are exhausting.
lines.zh: : 唉。青春期的小鬼真累人。

lines.en: I close my eyes and attempt to sleep standing up in the middle of the park.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，试着站在公园正中央睡着。

lines.en: It does not work.
lines.zh: 没有成功。

lines.en: So I proceed.
lines.zh: 于是我继续往前走。

lines.en: scene dormtown_night
My legs carry me somewhere not far from the dorms where, miraculously, I’ve only managed to deflower one girl.
lines.zh: 双腿把我带到离宿舍不远的地方——奇迹般地，我在这一带只夺走过一个女孩的初夜。

lines.en: You’d think after spending two complete[school] years in this place that I’d be fucking {i}everyone{/i} by now.
lines.zh: 你大概会以为，在这地方待完整整两个 [school] 学年，我现在应该已经把{i}每个人{/i}都干遍了。

lines.en: This place sucks.
lines.zh: 这地方烂透了。

lines.en: Kumon-mi sucks.
lines.zh: Kumon-mi 烂透了。

lines.en: Why couldn’t I have been tossed into one of those worlds where all of the girls throw themselves at me just for finding out the size of my penis?
lines.zh: 为什么我就不能被扔进那种世界里——女孩们光是知道了我的阴茎尺寸就对我投怀送抱？

lines.en: It’s a huge penis!
lines.zh: 那可是根大家伙！

lines.en: At least when it’s not cold out- like today.
lines.zh: 至少在天不冷的时候是这样——比如今天。

lines.en: : I wonder how Ami is doing?
lines.zh: : 不知道 Ami 怎么样了？

lines.en: When I last saw her, she was foaming from the mouth and her teeth were being ground into dust by some higher power.
lines.zh: 我最后一次见到她时，她口吐白沫，牙齿正被某种更高的存在磨成粉末。

lines.en: I want to say it was just a few hours ago but, to be honest, I can’t really confirm that.
lines.zh: 我想说那是区区几小时前的事，可说实话，我也没法确认。

lines.en: Something about the way the thoughts inside of my head are free-floating makes me think that it’s been much longer than just a few hours.
lines.zh: 我脑子里那些念头四处漂浮的样子，让我觉得已经过去了远不止几个小时。

lines.en: Days?
lines.zh: 几天？

lines.en: Weeks?
lines.zh: 几周？

lines.en: Months?
lines.zh: 几个月？

lines.en: Years?
lines.zh: 几年？

lines.en: Decades?
lines.zh: 几十年？

lines.en: Months?
lines.zh: 几个月？

lines.en: Centuries?
lines.zh: 几个世纪？

lines.en: Months?
lines.zh: 几个月？

lines.en: : Time is stupid.
lines.zh: : 时间真蠢。

lines.en: : Ami, return!
lines.zh: : Ami，回来！

lines.en: : You called?
lines.zh: : 你叫我？

lines.en: show amihappyyay
: Oh good. You’re okay.
lines.zh: : 太好了。你没事。

lines.en: : No I’m not! I’m horrible!
lines.zh: : 不，我有事！我糟糕透了！

lines.en: : In fact, I’m not even here. This version of me is just a memory.
lines.zh: : 其实，我根本就不在这里。这个版本的我只是段记忆。

lines.en: : A happy memory.
lines.zh: : 一段快乐的记忆。

lines.en: : Don’t I look just like my mom when I wear my special outfit?
lines.zh: : 我穿上那身特别的衣服，是不是跟我妈妈一模一样？

lines.en: : You know, because she wound up in a mangled pile of steel and gasoline and I, too, am mangled beyond recognition.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，因为她最后变成了一堆扭曲的钢铁和汽油，而我也同样被碾得面目全非。

lines.en: : That’s not true. It’s pretty easy to tell you’re Ami because your twintails are so freakishly long.
lines.zh: : 才不是。很容易就能认出你是 Ami，因为你的双马尾长得离谱。

lines.en: : Well don’t get too attached, bud! I let these babies down once it starts getting cold.
lines.zh: : 那你也别太上心啦，老兄！天一冷我就会把这两个宝贝放下来。

lines.en: : It’s no fun having my neck get all chilly from the decrease in temperature.
lines.zh: : 气温一降，脖子凉飕飕的，可一点都不好玩。

lines.en: : But I guess that won’t {i}technically{/i} be an issue since I have that really pretty scarf you bought me at the mall the other day!
lines.zh: : 不过{i}严格来说{/i}这也不算问题了，毕竟我还有你那天在商场给我买的、特别好看的那条围巾呢！

lines.en: : I’m glad you liked it. It only cost me 2,000 Yen and the employee I bought it from told me it wasn’t even supposed to be for sale.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢就好。只花了我两千日元，而且卖给我的店员说那东西本来根本不对外出售。

lines.en: : Oh whaaaaaaaaaaaaat? Wild.
lines.zh: : 哦—————真的假的？太离谱了吧。

lines.en: : Don’t tell that to Maya, though! She seemed to really like hers.
lines.zh: : 不过别跟 Maya 说啊！她看起来挺喜欢她那条的。

lines.en: Oh! Maya!
lines.zh: 哦！Maya！

lines.en: That’s who I was supposed to be meeting.
lines.zh: 我要见的就是她。

lines.en: This is that part where the thing happens, so she needs to do the thing to bring us back to the thing.
lines.zh: 这段就是“那件事”要发生的部分，所以她得做“那件事”，把我们带回“原来那样”。

lines.en: : It seemed to me like she hated it.
lines.zh: : 可我看她好像挺讨厌的。

lines.en: : People don’t normally collapse when receiving a gift they enjoy.
lines.zh: : 一般人收到喜欢的礼物时，是不会当场瘫倒的。

lines.en: : She’s a tough nut to crack, that Maya.
lines.zh: : 那个 Maya 可真难搞。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I feel like the only thing that would {i}actually{/i} crack her is dropping her off the roof of the[school] building and watching her land on her head. LOL!
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得，唯一{i}能让她“裂开”{/i}的办法，就是把她从 [school] 楼顶推下去，看她头着地。哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Jk. She’s my bff and I love her very much.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。她是我最好的朋友，我超爱她的。

lines.en: : Also, she has a really cute butt.
lines.zh: : 而且，她的屁股真的好可爱。

lines.en: : If I was born a boy I’d probably corner her in the locker room after everyone else left for the day and like, totally just pin her down and go to town. You know?
lines.zh: : 要是我生下来是个男孩，我大概会在其他人都走光之后把她堵在更衣室里，然后……直接把她按倒、大干一场。你懂吧？

lines.en: : The problem with that scenario is that she’d need to be in the locker room all alone after everyone else went home for some reason.
lines.zh: : 这个设想的问题在于，她得因为某种原因，在别人都回家之后独自待在更衣室里。

lines.en: : And that just doesn’t seem like a very {i}Maya{/i} thing to do.
lines.zh: : 而这看起来可不太像 {i}Maya{/i} 会做的事。

lines.en: : Hahahaha~ Leave it to the master of grooming [high_school] girls to perfectly strategize the way to sodomize them!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈～不愧是调教 [high_school] 女生的大师，连怎么把她们按住爆一遍都能算得这么周全！

lines.en: : Thankfully, I was born a girl- a cute one at that! So I only need to worry about being sodomized rather than sodomizing itself.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，我生下来是女孩——而且还是可爱的那种！所以我只需要担心被别人爆，而不用操心去爆别人。

lines.en: : Praise be!
lines.zh: : 赞美圣名！

lines.en: : Praise be!
lines.zh: : 赞美圣名！

lines.en: scene amibreak4
For some reason I can not comprehend, my head is stricken with an intense, throbbing pain after uttering those last words.
lines.zh: 不知为何，说完最后那句话后，我的头突然传来一阵剧烈的、跳动的疼痛。

lines.en: I can’t even remember what words they were since the pain has ousted them from my memory.
lines.zh: 我甚至记不清那是什么话了，因为疼痛已经把它们从我的记忆里赶了出去。

lines.en: What I do know, though, is that it’s...
lines.zh: 但我唯一知道的，是现在……

lines.en: : TIME TO GET A MOVE ONNNNNNN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: WOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 哇哦哦哦哦哦哦哦！！！！！！！

lines.en: scene black
scene street_night
show amihappyyay
: Hey, where are you going?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Don’t you wanna have some fun, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 你不想找点乐子吗，[amimaster]？

lines.en: : We’re all alone in Kumon-mi now! We can do whatever we want.
lines.zh: : 现在整座 Kumon-mi 就剩我们俩了！我们想干什么都行。

lines.en: : It might even be a good opportunity for you to FUCK ME ALREADY!!!!!!! AHHHHHHH!!!!!
lines.zh: : 说不定这还是个好机会，让你终于可以干我了！！！！！！！啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

lines.en: : I CAN ONLY TOUCH MYSELF SO MUCH BEFORE IT STARTS TO HURT!
lines.zh: : 我自己摸再多下去，就要开始疼了！

lines.en: : As great as that sounds, I feel suddenly compelled to go to[school].
lines.zh: : 听上去是很棒，可我突然有种非去 [school] 不可的冲动。

lines.en: : School? But you hate school.
lines.zh: : 学校？可你最讨厌学校了。

lines.en: : It’s harder to do fun stuff there. And you always used to talk about how you hate the way the other teachers look at you.
lines.zh: : 在那儿干好玩的事更难。而且你以前总说，你讨厌别的老师看你的眼神。

lines.en: : Did I?
lines.zh: : 我说过吗？

lines.en: : I don’t remember that.
lines.zh: : 我不记得了。

lines.en: : Mhm! You always said that they made you feel less human and that you wish they’d all just go away.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！你总说他们让你觉得自己不那么像个人，还说真希望他们全都消失。

lines.en: : But rejoice, [amimaster]! They have gone away!
lines.zh: : 可是欢呼吧，[amimaster]！他们真的消失了！

lines.en: : So maybe it’s finally safe to go back to[school] after all.
lines.zh: : 所以也许现在终于可以安心回 [school] 了。

lines.en: : Either way, though. I feel a little weird about it.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我总觉得有点怪怪的。

lines.en: : Like I’m going to suddenly vanish for good if you actually make it there or something.
lines.zh: : 就好像你要是真走到了那儿，我就会彻底消失似的。

lines.en: : You already did vanish for good, though.
lines.zh: : 可你已经彻底消失过了啊。

lines.en: : If I vanished then how come I’m still here talking to you? Huh?
lines.zh: : 那要是我消失了，怎么现在还在跟你说话？嗯？

lines.en: : How do you explain that, mister?
lines.zh: : 这个你怎么解释，先生？

lines.en: : Easy.
lines.zh: : 简单。

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不解释。

lines.en: : Ughhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh BORING.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃——无聊死了。

lines.en: : But fine. If you wanna go to[school] and talk to your desks again, be my guest.
lines.zh: : 行吧。你要是想回 [school] 继续跟你的课桌说话，随你便。

lines.en: : I’ll just keep watching from somewhere up above.
lines.zh: : 我就在上面某个地方继续看着你好了。

lines.en: : Goodbye, [amimaster]!
lines.zh: : 再见啦，[amimaster]！

lines.en: : See you in a few months!
lines.zh: : 几个月后见！

lines.en: : Or maybe before that now that the rumbling has stopped!
lines.zh: : 不过现在那阵轰鸣停了，也许会更快哦！

lines.en: Ami flies away and crashes into a cloud somewhere miles above me.
lines.zh: Ami 飞走了，撞进了上方几英里外的一朵云里。

lines.en: It makes a slight “poof”ing noise that reminds me of the sound a marshmallow makes when falling off of a stick.
lines.zh: 发出轻微的“噗”的一声，让我想起棉花糖从签子上掉下来时的声音。

lines.en: And then my journey continues.
lines.zh: 然后我的旅程继续。

lines.en: scene black
scene manganight
I walk into the Manga Club room.
lines.zh: 我走进了漫画社的活动室。

lines.en: I feel like I made a mistake somewhere.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己哪里搞错了。

lines.en: This isn’t where I am supposed to be.
lines.zh: 我该去的地方不是这里。

lines.en: scene black
I leave.
lines.zh: 我离开了。

lines.en: scene storeroom_night
Wtf.
lines.zh: 什么鬼。

lines.en: I don’t even know what this room is.
lines.zh: 我连这间屋子是什么都不知道。

lines.en: How did I even end up in here?
lines.zh: 我到底是怎么走到这儿来的？

lines.en: scene black
If only there was someone here to guide me.
lines.zh: 要是这儿有个人能给我指路就好了。

lines.en: Someone with more eyes than I could see.
lines.zh: 一个眼睛比我看得见的多得多的人。

lines.en: Someone with invisible arms who could cause hearts to beat just by massaging them with his big, awesome hands made of shadows and tree branches.
lines.zh: 一个有着隐形手臂的人，只要用他那双由阴影和树枝构成的、又大又棒的手按摩一下，就能让心脏重新跳动。

lines.en: But alas-
lines.zh: 可惜啊——

lines.en: I am alone.
lines.zh: 我孤身一人。

lines.en: scene hall_night
: Hah...
I’m suddenly hit by a wave of depression.
lines.zh: 一阵抑郁突然涌上心头。

lines.en: Kind of like the waves that hit Rin and make her carve things into her arms and then lie about them.
lines.zh: 有点像席卷 Rin 的那种浪潮，会让她在手臂上刻下什么，然后再为此撒谎。

lines.en: Or the kind of waves that would cause a girl to jump off the top of the world only to be transported right back to where she jumped from.
lines.zh: 或者是那种会让一个女孩从世界顶端跳下去，却又被直接送回起跳之处的浪潮。

lines.en: Thankfully, something like that has yet to happen to me!
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，这种事还没发生在我身上！

lines.en: : Hah...
But still.
lines.zh: 可尽管如此。

lines.en: I wish I knew where to go.
lines.zh: 我真希望自己知道该去哪儿。

lines.en: : Hah...
: This sucks...
lines.zh: : 糟透了……

lines.en: : Hah...
: Hah...
: Ugh...
I do my best impression of depression and then laugh to myself for rhyming inside of my thoughts.
lines.zh: 我尽力摆出一副抑郁的样子，然后又因为在心里押上了韵而自顾自笑了起来。

lines.en: I should write poetry!
lines.zh: 我应该去写诗！

lines.en: Maybe then, girls will think I’m sensitive and will allow me to slip inside of them before getting to like, six hundred affection or something.
lines.zh: 那样女孩们也许会觉得我很细腻，然后在好感度刷到什么六百之前，就让我滑进她们的身体里。

lines.en: Who even knows how long it will take for some of those {b}bitchezzzzz.{/b}
lines.zh: 谁知道对付那几个{b}贱人{/b}要花多久呢。

lines.en: scene black
I wander around forever.
lines.zh: 我永远四处游荡。

lines.en: I never leave the[school].
lines.zh: 我从未离开过 [school]。

lines.en: I never leave anywhere.
lines.zh: 我哪儿也没离开过。

lines.en: I plant my legs in the ground.
lines.zh: 我把双腿扎进地里。

lines.en: They turn into roots.
lines.zh: 它们变成了根。

lines.en: The roots turn into wires.
lines.zh: 根又变成了电线。

lines.en: And it isn’t until then that I realize where I need to go.
lines.zh: 直到那时，我才意识到自己该去哪儿。

lines.en: scene secondreset1
A normal [teenage]girl stands atop the roof of the[school] building and clasps her hands together in prayer to someone she claims to not believe in.
lines.zh: 一个普通的 [teenage] 女孩站在 [school] 楼顶，双手合十，向某个她声称自己并不信仰的对象祈祷着。

lines.en: Either that or she’s praying to the stars themselves, which seems highly probable given that the girl has a hard-on for stars.
lines.zh: 要么她是在向星星本身祈祷——鉴于这女孩对星星痴迷得不行，这种可能性还挺大的。

lines.en: I want to say something snippy but I find my mouth sewn shut by a string that comes to life and crawls away from the girl’s scarf and onto my lips.
lines.zh: 我想说点刻薄话，却发现自己的嘴被一根线缝住了——那根线活了过来，从女孩的围巾上爬到了我的嘴唇上。

lines.en: I try to pull the string off and wind up shredding my mouth in the process.
lines.zh: 我试图把线扯掉，结果把嘴撕得稀烂。

lines.en: But it will all be worth it once I can talk to her.
lines.zh: 但只要能跟她说上话，这一切都值得。

lines.en: For I just remembered the important thing that’s going to happen tonight.
lines.zh: 因为我刚刚想起了今晚将要发生的那件重要的事。

lines.en: She is going to reset the world!
lines.zh: 她要重置这个世界！

lines.en: And everything will go back to being okay!
lines.zh: 然后一切都会恢复正常！

lines.en: And look!
lines.zh: 而且你看！

lines.en: She’s already dressed for the occasion!
lines.zh: 她已经为这个场合换好行头了！

lines.en: : Not bad.
lines.zh: : 不错嘛。

lines.en: scene secondreset2
: You got here quicker than last time.
lines.zh: : 你这次来得比上次快。

lines.en: : Did I?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : How long did the last time take?
lines.zh: : 上次花了多久？

lines.en: : Too long.
lines.zh: : 太久。

lines.en: : And this time?
lines.zh: : 那这次呢？

lines.en: : Less than a day.
lines.zh: : 不到一天。

lines.en: : I only just got here myself.
lines.zh: : 我自己也是刚到。

lines.en: : Really? Maybe I should try doing the reset then.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那也许我该试试做重置。

lines.en: : Do you think you can?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能行？

lines.en: : Probably not. What do I even have to do?
lines.zh: : 大概不行。我到底要做什么？

lines.en: : Last time, you just made me stand here and hugged me. Then, all of a sudden, I was waking up again.
lines.zh: : 上次你只是让我站在这儿，然后抱了我一下。接着突然之间，我就又醒过来了。

lines.en: : It was really disorienting.
lines.zh: : 那感觉真的很迷失方向。

lines.en: : All you really need to do is pray.
lines.zh: : 你要做的其实只是祈祷而已。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Are you sure you still want to try?
lines.zh: : 你确定还想试试吗？

lines.en: : No, I’m good. I’ll leave the praying to you.
lines.zh: : 不了，我还是算了。祈祷这种事就交给你吧。

lines.en: : You look cute with your hands clasped together like that anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正你双手合十的样子挺可爱的。

lines.en: scene secondreset3
: Is now really the best time to be hitting on me?
lines.zh: : 现在真的是撩我的好时候吗？

lines.en: : Can I ask you a rooftop question now?
lines.zh: : 我现在可以问你一个天台问题了吗？

lines.en: : Well, we’re on the roof...so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们确实在天台上……所以……

lines.en: : If everyone else vanished and the two of us were left all alone in the world, would you consider getting closer to me then?
lines.zh: : 如果其他人都消失了，世上只剩下我们两个，你会考虑跟我更亲近一些吗？

lines.en: scene secondreset4
: Ha ha ha...very funny...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……真好笑……

lines.en: : I’m glad to see you’re back to normal, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少我很高兴看到你恢复正常了。

lines.en: scene secondreset5
: I caught a glimpse of you wandering through the park earlier and you looked even more disgusting than normal.
lines.zh: : 刚才我瞥见你在公园里游荡，那副样子比平时更恶心。

lines.en: : I think you even went to take your clothes off at one point.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你甚至一度还打算把衣服脱掉。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see you’re back to normal as well.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴看到你恢复正常。

lines.en: : I’m always normal. It’s my defining characteristic.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很正常。这是我的标志性特征。

lines.en: : Well you definitely seemed to have a hard time living up to that after getting my present- which I’m glad to see you’re wearing already.
lines.zh: : 那你收到我礼物之后，可明显有点配不上这句话了——不过我很高兴看到你已经戴上了。

lines.en: I point at the scarf and Maya does not react.
lines.zh: 我指了指围巾，Maya 毫无反应。

lines.en: She probably prepared for me to say something about that.
lines.zh: 她大概早就准备好我会说点什么了。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : I’m only wearing this because it’s going to become very cold as soon as we’re done.
lines.zh: : 我戴这个只是因为等我们忙完，天会变得很冷。

lines.en: : And also-
lines.zh: : 而且——

lines.en: scene secondreset6
: It makes me look very cute.
lines.zh: : 它让我看起来很可爱。

lines.en: : Was that you breaking character again?
lines.zh: : 你又破功了？

lines.en: : No. But at the end of the day- or I guess the end of the world in this case, I’m still just a girl.
lines.zh: : 没有。但说到底——或者说在这个情况下，是“世界末日”——我终究只是个女孩。

lines.en: : A rather unlucky one, but still just a girl.
lines.zh: : 一个运气相当差的女孩，但终究只是个女孩。

lines.en: : And girls my age care about little things like this.
lines.zh: : 而我这个年纪的女孩，就是会在意这种小事。

lines.en: : You’ll find out more about that through others soon enough, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我相信你很快就会从别人身上了解到更多。

lines.en: : But for now, please allow me to take pride in my image without feeling awkward or indebted to you for not getting you a present in return.
lines.zh: : 但现在，请允许我为自己的形象得意一下，别让我觉得尴尬，也别让我因为没回送你礼物而觉得欠你什么。

lines.en: : Actually, strike that.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。

lines.en: : My present to you will be resetting the world.
lines.zh: : 我送你的礼物，就是重置这个世界。

lines.en: : You were going to do that anyway.
lines.zh: : 你本来就要这么做的。

lines.en: : I was. But now it is a present.
lines.zh: : 是。但现在它是礼物了。

lines.en: : There is no need to thank me.
lines.zh: : 不必谢我。

lines.en: : I wasn’t going to...
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算……

lines.en: scene secondreset7
Maya finally loosens her posture and turns to face me.
lines.zh: Maya 终于放松了姿势，转过身面对我。

lines.en: The glow of different colored stars all disappear behind different meteors or floating rocks or whatever those things I never bothered learning about are called.
lines.zh: 各色星辰的光芒尽数被不同的流星或漂浮的岩石——或者那些我从没费心去弄清名字的东西——遮住了。

lines.en: : So, is there anything you’d like to talk about before we start over?
lines.zh: : 那么，在重新开始之前，你有什么想聊的吗？

lines.en: : We have all the time in the world.
lines.zh: : 我们有的是时间。

lines.en: menu secreset:
I had a dream this morning
lines.zh: 我今天早上做了个梦

lines.en: : I had a strange dream this morning.
lines.zh: : 我今天早上做了一个奇怪的梦。

lines.en: : Strange enough to warrant bringing it up at a time like this?
lines.zh: : 奇怪到值得在这种时候提出来？

lines.en: : I think so.
lines.zh: : 我觉得值得。

lines.en: : It was a dream about some sort of...god made of wires or something.
lines.zh: : 那是一个关于某种……由电线构成的神之类的梦。

lines.en: : That sounds like a dream I would have.
lines.zh: : 听起来像是我会做的梦。

lines.en: : I thought so too on account of how boring it was.
lines.zh: : 我也这么想，因为它实在太无聊了。

lines.en: scene secondreset8
: Really?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : If you’re just going to insult me, I don’t want to hear about your dream.
lines.zh: : 如果你只是想侮辱我，那我可不想听你的梦。

lines.en: : It’s called a joke. Relax.
lines.zh: : 那叫玩笑。放松点。

lines.en: : Anyway, I was wondering if you knew anything about that.
lines.zh: : 总之，我想知道你对此是否了解。

lines.en: : You’re a shrine maiden so you know...god-related stuff. Right?
lines.zh: : 你是巫女，所以你应该懂……跟神有关的东西吧？

lines.en: scene secondreset9
: I do. But it’s not like I’ve ever studied things like that. I’ve just found them out over time.
lines.zh: : 我懂。但我并没有专门研究过那些东西，只是随着时间慢慢了解到的。

lines.en: : This particular story isn’t something I’m familiar with, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你说的这个故事，我并不熟悉。

lines.en: : I’ve never heard of any sort of...wire-related higher power before.
lines.zh: : 我从没听说过什么……跟电线有关的高等存在。

lines.en: : The gods that people acknowledge here all have ties to spirituality or the afterlife or other things you wouldn’t want to be bothered learning about.
lines.zh: : 这里人们承认的神，都跟灵性、来世，或者其他你根本不想费心去了解的东西有关。

lines.en: : A god not related to any of those things could simply not exist.
lines.zh: : 与这些都无关的神，可能根本就不存在。

lines.en: scene secondreset7
: But, then again, I suppose a god can be anything that you want to believe in.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，神大概可以是任何你愿意相信的东西。

lines.en: : I’ll continue to not believe in any of them.
lines.zh: : 我会继续一个都不信。

lines.en: : If you want some random dream you had in a state of delirium to guide you through the future, feel free. That’s your right.
lines.zh: : 如果你想让一个在神志不清时做的、随便什么梦来指引你的未来，请便。那是你的权利。

lines.en: : Just know that I’ll think you’re an idiot.
lines.zh: : 但你得知道，我会觉得你是个白痴。

lines.en: : You already think I’m an idiot, Maya. You tell me all the time.
lines.zh: : 你本来就觉得我是白痴啊，Maya。你天天都这么说。

lines.en: scene secondreset10
: You’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: : So I guess I’ll just think you’re {i}more{/i} of an idiot for believing in something like that.
lines.zh: : 所以我想，我会因为你信这种东西，而觉得你{i}更{/i}白痴一点。

lines.en: $ reset2q1 = True
jump secreset
Does anyone else know about this?
lines.zh: 还有别人知道这件事吗？

lines.en: : Does anyone else know about what happens at the end of the world?
lines.zh: : 还有别人知道世界末日时会发生什么吗？

lines.en: scene secondreset7
: How could they know about this when they all disappear?
lines.zh: : 他们全都消失了，怎么会知道？

lines.en: : I guess what I’m really asking is...how can you be sure they’ve all disappeared?
lines.zh: : 我想我真正想问的是……你怎么能确定他们都已经消失了？

lines.en: scene secondreset11
: Wow. That’s actually a good question.
lines.zh: : 哇。这倒真是个好问题。

lines.en: : I might even be a little impressed.
lines.zh: : 我甚至有点刮目相看了。

lines.en: : Thanks, but I could deal without the sudden shock at me saying something with a slight hint of logic.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，不过你对我说出一句稍微带点逻辑的话就如此震惊，我倒是可以不要。

lines.en: scene secondreset7
: You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : I suppose there’s no way for me to tell where everyone is at all times...
lines.zh: : 我想，我也确实没办法随时知道每个人在哪儿……

lines.en: : But the fact that even information related to those who disappear is sucked away during the end of the world is a testament to them not existing at all anymore.
lines.zh: : 但就连与消失者相关的信息，也会在世界末日时被一并抽走——这恰恰证明他们已经彻底不存在了。

lines.en: : So not only does everyone disappear, their belongings disappear. Their social media profiles disappear.
lines.zh: : 所以不只是人会消失，他们的随身物品会消失，他们的社交媒体账号也会消失。

lines.en: : Even those creepy pictures you keep of them in your secret journal disappear.
lines.zh: : 连你藏在秘密日记本里那些变态照片，也一并消失。

lines.en: : Wait, how do you know about those?
lines.zh: : 等等，你怎么知道那些的？

lines.en: : I’ve had plenty of time to figure things out.
lines.zh: : 我有的是时间去把事情弄明白。

lines.en: scene secondreset13
: But, basically, I wouldn’t worry about anyone somehow finding out about this unless they wind up on the roof with us.
lines.zh: : 不过基本上，除非有人跟我们一起出现在天台上，否则你不用担心会被谁发现。

lines.en: : That’s never happened before, and I can’t imagine it happening any time soon.
lines.zh: : 这种事从来没发生过，我也想象不出短期内会发生。

lines.en: $ reset2q2 = True
jump secreset
Are you okay?
lines.zh: 你还好吗？

lines.en: : You don’t have to answer this one if you don’t want to, but...
lines.zh: : 如果你不想回答可以不答，不过……

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene secondreset14
: Am I okay?
lines.zh: : 我好不好？

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : It just...feels kind of shitty that you’ve gone through this so many times to the point where you’ve become sort of desensitized to it.
lines.zh: : 只是……你已经经历了这么多次，甚至有点麻木了，这让我觉得挺难受的。

lines.en: : That must weigh on you, right?
lines.zh: : 那一定压得你很累吧？

lines.en: scene secondreset15
: Hmm...
: You said I don’t have to answer that if I don’t want to, right?
lines.zh: : 你说过我不想答就可以不答，对吧？

lines.en: : Right.
: Then I think I’ll abstain for the time being.
lines.zh: : 那我想暂时还是不答了。

lines.en: : But do know that there is a reason I constantly refer to myself as the girl with the worst luck in the world-
lines.zh: : 但你要知道，我总把自己称作世上运气最差的女孩，是有原因的——

lines.en: : And only part of that reason is that I wound up with someone like you as my teacher.
lines.zh: : 而这原因里只有一部分，是我摊上了你这么个人当老师。

lines.en: : I’ll never cease to be amazed at how you can show disdain for me even when I’m trying to be kind.
lines.zh: : 我永远都会惊讶于，即使我在试着善意相待，你也能对我露出轻蔑。

lines.en: : And I’ll never cease to be amazed at how often you try to be kind despite being the worst person I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 而我也永远会惊讶于，尽管你是我见过最差劲的人，却还是那么频繁地试图展现善意。

lines.en: : Now, what else do you want to talk about?
lines.zh: : 那么，你还想聊点什么？

lines.en: $ reset2q3 = True
jump secreset
I guess that’s all
lines.zh: 我想就这些了

lines.en: : I guess that’s all I really wanted to talk about this time.
lines.zh: : 我想这次我真正想聊的，就这些了。

lines.en: : Was it really necessary to bring the winter outfit, though?
lines.zh: : 不过真的有必要带那身冬装来吗？

lines.en: scene secondreset16
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然有必要。

lines.en: : After all, things can become a little messy during the changing of seasons.
lines.zh: : 毕竟，季节更替的时候，事情会变得有点麻烦。

lines.en: : Messy? What do you mean by {i}messy?{/i}
lines.zh: : 麻烦？你说的{i}麻烦{/i}是什么意思？

lines.en: : I told you the first time, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我第一次就告诉过你了，不是吗？

lines.en: : That sometimes, things go wrong when I try to do this.
lines.zh: : 有时候我试着这么做，事情会出错。

lines.en: : Ushering in a change in temperature, which basically equates to a change in the world itself, sometimes mixes with all of the other things that need to be reset and causes a hiccup in the process.
lines.zh: : 气温的变化，说白了就等于世界本身的变化，有时会和所有其他需要被重置的东西混在一起，让整个过程出点岔子。

lines.en: : It’s incredibly inconvenient and I’m pretty sure it’s directly tied to both my mental state and how willing {i}God{/i} is to listen.
lines.zh: : 这麻烦得要命，而且我敢肯定，这跟我的精神状态、以及{i}上帝{/i}有多愿意倾听，都有直接关系。

lines.en: : I am suddenly significantly more worried about this.
lines.zh: : 我突然为这事担心了不少。

lines.en: scene secondreset17
: Rest assured, I am of sound body and mind right now and foresee this particular reset going smoothly.
lines.zh: : 放心吧，我现在身心健康，预感这次重置会顺利进行。

lines.en: : In fact, I am so sure of this reset’s success that I have dressed for the occasion and am ready for snow immediately upon completion.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我对这次重置的成功有十足把握，所以才为这个场合换好行头，一结束就能立刻迎接落雪。

lines.en: : That’s good at least.
lines.zh: : 至少这点是好的。

lines.en: : Waiting at that bistro for Ami and me to show up after[school] would probably be annoying without your current get-up.
lines.zh: : 要是没有你这身打扮，[school] 放学后在小酒馆等着我和 Ami 出现，大概会很难受。

lines.en: scene secondreset7
: Oh, about that.
lines.zh: : 哦，说到这个。

lines.en: : That’s probably not going to happen this time.
lines.zh: : 这次大概不会发生了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : We have somewhere else we need to be when we’re done here.
lines.zh: : 等这里忙完，我们还有别的地方要去。

lines.en: : How do we already have plans for the future?
lines.zh: : 我们怎么连未来的计划都安排好了？

lines.en: : Because the future is also the past. Or something.
lines.zh: : 因为未来也是过去。大概吧。

lines.en: : This world makes no sense at all.
lines.zh: : 这个世界完全讲不通。

lines.en: : Nothing makes sense- but here we are. Alone at the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 什么都说不通——可我们还是在这里。在世界末日里，孤身二人。

lines.en: : The same as always.
lines.zh: : 一如既往。

lines.en: : Now, close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 现在，闭上眼睛。

lines.en: scene black
: Are you going to hug me again?
lines.zh: : 你又要抱我吗？

lines.en: : Reluctantly.
lines.zh: : 勉为其难吧。

lines.en: Maya takes a step toward me and stops inches away.
lines.zh: Maya 朝我迈了一步，在离我只有几英寸的地方停住。

lines.en: The sound of her breathing is drowned out by the vacuum of space, but I can feel her eyes on me.
lines.zh: 她的呼吸声被太空的真空吞没，但我能感觉到她的目光落在我身上。

lines.en: It makes me uncomfortable and my posture may or may not be reflecting that right now.
lines.zh: 这让我很不自在，而我现在的姿势大概正反映着这一点。

lines.en: I obviously can’t see anything with my eyes closed.
lines.zh: 眼睛闭着，我当然什么都看不见。

lines.en: : Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: : Let’s try this.
lines.zh: : 我们换个方式吧。

lines.en: : Give me your hands.
lines.zh: : 把你的手给我。

lines.en: : My hands?
lines.zh: : 我的手？

lines.en: scene secondreset18
Maya’s fingers curl around mine, which I’m sure is a lot easier on her than actually wrapping her arms around me.
lines.zh: Maya 的手指缠上了我的手——我敢肯定，这对她来说比真的用手臂环住我容易多了。

lines.en: This way, she’s able to keep her body from pressing up against mine and can continue pretending that I’m actually heartless instead of accidentally hearing the beating of said muscle in my chest.
lines.zh: 这样一来，她既不用让身体贴上来，也可以继续假装我真的铁石心肠，而不会不小心听见我胸口那块肌肉的跳动。

lines.en: : You are annoyingly tall.
lines.zh: : 你高得真烦人。

lines.en: : You are obnoxiously short.
lines.zh: : 你矮得真讨厌。

lines.en: : I’m only slightly shorter than I’m supposed to be at my age.
lines.zh: : 我只是比我这年纪该有的身高稍微矮了一点而已。

lines.en: : Your height surpasses that of the average Japanese adult male by at least five inches.
lines.zh: : 而你的身高，比日本成年男性的平均值高出至少五英寸。

lines.en: : Do we need to be closer than this after all? Should I lift you up?
lines.zh: : 那我们到底要不要再靠近点？要不我把你举起来？

lines.en: : Try to lift me and I will reset the world by myself.
lines.zh: : 你敢举我，我就自己一个人重置世界。

lines.en: : But then how will I make it to whatever place we’re supposed to go to after this?
lines.zh: : 那我怎么去我们之后该去的那个地方？

lines.en: : I will go alone. It would be easier that way anyway.
lines.zh: : 那我就一个人去。反正那样也更省事。

lines.en: : Well thank you for going out of your way for me.
lines.zh: : 那还真是谢谢您特意为我着想了。

lines.en: : And thank you in advance for not lifting me up.
lines.zh: : 也提前谢谢你不把我举起来。

lines.en: scene secondreset19
My eyes are still closed, so I can’t tell what Maya is doing.
lines.zh: 我的眼睛还闭着，所以不知道 Maya 在做什么。

lines.en: But something about the way her hands begin to hold onto mine a little tighter tells me that-
lines.zh: 但她握住我的手开始紧了几分，那感觉在告诉我——
